I solved this by hand with a case analysis on Ben's slot, and the schedule satisfies all 17 constraints.

Ben can only be in slot 5 or 6. Finn, Gus, Hana and Ivo must all come before him, and Ann is directly after him. Slot 6 forces Elif into slot 9, which leaves Dev with no later slot, so Ben must be in slot 5. That fixes Ann at 6, Cara at 7 and Elif at 8, leaves Dev in 9, and makes slots 1–4 a tight puzzle. Only Finn in 1, Ivo in 2, Hana in 3 and Gus in 4 fits the remaining constraints.

I checked each constraint against this arrangement and all hold, including the gap rules (Gus–Cara 3, Finn–Gus 3, Ann–Hana 3, Dev–Finn 8, Ivo–Elif 6) and "exactly one person between Ann and Elif" (Cara in slot 7).
